name: Panther Mastery
summary: Sir S. J. Erlgadin has set the final trial of his panther hunt before you in northern Stranglethorn Vale. Having proven your skill against the region's panthers, you are challenged to seek out Bhag'thera, an elusive predator that has so far eluded the expedition's party. Bringing back the beast's fang will establish your standing as a true master of the hunt.

sections.title: The Elusive Prowler
sections.body: At Nesingwary's Expedition, Sir S. J. Erlgadin considers your trials nearly complete. One final quarry remains to prove your worth against the jungle's predators: a panther named Bhag'thera. The beast has so far eluded the expedition's own party as it prowls the wilds of Stranglethorn Vale. Erlgadin calls on you to track down this great stalker and claim the Fang of Bhag'thera as proof of your skill.

faq.answer: Sir S. J. Erlgadin gives this challenge at Nesingwary's Expedition in northern Stranglethorn Vale.
The quarry is Bhag'thera, a great panther that prowls the jungle and has so far eluded the expedition's party.
Sir S. J. Erlgadin requires the Fang of Bhag'thera as evidence of the beast's defeat.
This challenge follows the third trial in the Panther Mastery line, building on the earlier panther hunts.
